component.name: XtreamTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "runJob" end sub
sub runJob() j = m.top.job url = j.server + "/player_api.php?username=" + urlEsc(j.user) + "&password=" + urlEsc(j.pass) + "&action=" + j.action if j.catId <> invalid and j.catId <> "" then url = url + "&category_id=" + urlEsc(j.catId) r = httpReq(url, "GET", "", invalid, 30000) data = invalid if r.code = 200 then data = ParseJson(r.body) if data = invalid then data = [] m.top.result = { action: j.action, catId: j.catId, ok: (r.code = 200), code: r.code, data: data } end sub
